messages:
morgan: Heads up — after the midnight deploy we started seeing SSO login failures for a subset of users. Errors show 'session signature invalid' and a bunch of SCIM provisioning retries. Anyone oncall? :rotating_light:
ara: saw the alerts, auth-proxy returning 401 with log msg 'signature_mismatch' for cookie validation. small spike ~00:02-00:14 UTC. :eyes:
sam: deploy bot shows release 2026-03-23T00:05 applied to auth services. infra-bot: Deploy 2026-03-23T00:05 applied on prod (deploy-237).
jules: I rotated the 'alias/sso-signing' key yesterday as part of the quarterly rotation. Did not expect immediate fallout — what error codes are we seeing from KMS?
morgan: logs show KMS errors when validating HMAC: "InvalidRequestException: Key state incompatible with operation" and sometimes 400 on GenerateMac. Example log: `AUTH_VALIDATE tid=abcd123 err=signature_mismatch kms_err=InvalidRequestException op=GenerateMac key=alias/sso-signing`
ara: also seeing a fallback attempt to local-key-cache but the cache ttl for that key is 0 due to config change. So verification fails instead of using cached mac.
sam: quick sanity: our auth path uses KMS GenerateMac (symmetric HMAC) for cookie mac checks. If the key was changed to asymmetric/SignVerify we'd get that error. Did the rotation change key spec?
jules: I... might have created a new key version with asymmetric attributes by accident while rewrapping. I pushed a createRequest that used KeySpec: RSA_2048 instead of SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT for the new version. sorry.
security-oncall: tagging this P0 and starting triage. We need impact numbers and mitigation plan.
morgan: mitigation plan draft: 1) rollback alias to previous key version that supports GenerateMac (immediate). 2) enable temporary tolerant verification using previous key for 60m while rewrap completes. 3) surface alert + audit of sessions created 1719450000-1719460000. 4) retry SCIM queue for failed provisions.
ara: reproducer command (do not paste secrets): `echo -n "user|ts|nonce" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac '$KEY' -binary | base64` — our code path calls KMS GenerateMac instead. When KMS returns InvalidRequest the code treats as fatal.
sam: I can push a hotfix to auth-proxy: catch InvalidRequestException and attempt alias->previousKey fallback for verification and increment a metric. wfm for quick mitigation.
jules: starting alias rollback to previous key version now. infra-bot: Rewrap/alias change job started by jules at 1719459045 (job-zz23).
infra-bot: Rewrap/alias change completed at 1719459090, alias now points to key/v4 (previous symmetric).
morgan: can folks verify login & SCIM retries?
ara: tested login for one impacted user — validation now succeeds. SCIM retry worker processed 15 queued provisioning events, 14 succeeded, 1 still failing with unrelated HTTP 403 from downstream.
jules: will follow up with a post-incident doc: update rotation checklist to validate KeySpec == SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT and that policy allows kms:GenerateMac & kms:VerifyMac. Also add smoke test that exercises auth-proxy HMAC validation after any key rotation.
security-oncall: please open an incident ticket with impact estimates (unique affected sessions, tenants), and attach KMS audit log slice. If >50 unique tenants, escalate to legal/compliance.
morgan: opened INC-2026-1142 and added initial notes + logs. Thanks all for quick turnaround.
ara: adding alerts: metric(kms_generate_mac_invalid_request) -> page security-oncall if rate > 5/min for 10m.
sam: will prepare a small code change to detect key type mismatch and fail safe to previous key for a short window; also add an admin-run 'verify-rotation' script.
jules: again, sorry — will own the postmortem and checklist changes.
morgan: great, closing this thread when postmortem link is up.
